data.caption: End-to-end cost per policy, medians of 16 confirmation weeks (301--316; trace lender, full menu, $\mu/\tilde\beta=1$).
data.note: ALG/LB: the first day of weeks 301--304 (5-min routing, reduced menu) over the LP bound, an upper bound on the ratio to the offline optimum. $p^\ast$: lower median over weeks 301--304 of the first i.i.d.\ reclaim probability with $r_0>1$ (0.00: $r_0>1$ already without reclaims; none: $r_0\le1$ at every $p\le1$; $>$0.2: likewise, but only $p\le0.2$ ran). Guarded rows: per-group allowance $\min\{\Wk,\mathrm{LB}'\}$. Theorem~\ref{thm:fullmodel}'s bound held in 448 of 448 guarded runs (trace, five stress and honoring lenders; 112 of Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard (\mbox{$B_0=10\%$} of the all-fallback bill); cases (a) 382, (b) 66); Corollary~\ref{cor:ratio}(b) holds for Sublet and Sublet, one-way, on core instances (Lemma~\ref{lem:projection}(e)); Sublet, one-way aborted in 42 of 112 runs (under the trace lender in 6 of 16 weeks, at the all-fallback bill; in the rest at Sublet's cost); Sublet and Greedy + guard in none. Primary baselines (H1): Greedy renting; Greedy, back-off; RetroRenting-style; Per-borrower ski rental; SpotHedge-style, \mbox{$N_{\mathrm{Extra}}=0$}; CoCaR-style; and RetroRenting-style, lagged (supplement). Provision for peak: 24.3 times the all-fallback bill in overflow accounting.
